== problems
- package mypkg couldn't be installed: see pacman's message above, then try: sudo pacman -S mypkg
- login shell /usr/bin/zsh isn't installed, so alice keeps their current one: install it, then run: sudo usermod -s /usr/bin/zsh alice
- couldn't enable sshd.service (its package may not be installed): try: sudo systemctl enable sshd.service
- alice wasn't signed in, so their units weren't enabled: after they sign in, they run: systemctl --user enable rclone-mount.service
- cargo ripgrep couldn't be installed: see the messages above, then try as alice: cargo install --locked ripgrep
